dataset: Amarsi, Nissen & Skuladottir 2019 — C I / O I 3D-NLTE and 1D-NLTE abundance correction grids
citation: Amarsi A.M., Nissen P.E., Skuladottir A. 2019, A&A 630, A104 (bibcode 2019A&A...630A.104A; arXiv:1908.10319)
license: Free for scientific use with citation (CDS terms); no author contact required.
downloaded_by: RYA-359 (Claude Code) via curl from the CDS FTP
notes: table4 (Fe II 3L-1L corrections) intentionally NOT vendored — not needed (Fe NLTE is served by the MPIA/Bergemann grid, RYA-319).
Large 1D-leg tables (table5/table6) vendored gzip-compressed; the loader reads .gz transparently. md5 below is of the gzipped file as downloaded from CDS.
table1 wavelengths are in nm; the loader converts to Angstrom at the load boundary (pipeline is A throughout).
O I '777nm'/'844nm'/'926nm' grid labels are multiplet-averaged corrections (integrated across all components) per the CDS ReadMe Note (1); applied as a single per-multiplet correction.

ReadMe.content: CDS byte-by-byte description for all tables

table1.dat.content: Line parameters (Species, Line label, lambda_air nm, lambda_vac nm, chi eV, log gf, log gamma_nat, ABO sigma/alpha)

table2.dat.gz.content: 3D non-LTE - 1D LTE abundance corrections for C I (the 3D leg, Teff <= ~6500 K)

table3.dat.gz.content: 3D non-LTE - 1D LTE abundance corrections for O I (the 3D leg, Teff <= ~6500 K)

table5.dat.gz.content: 1D non-LTE - 1D LTE abundance corrections for C I (the above-3D-ceiling leg, to 8000 K)

table6.dat.gz.content: 1D non-LTE - 1D LTE abundance corrections for O I (the above-3D-ceiling leg, to 8000 K)

table7.dat.content: Sample-star parameters + abundances (3N/1N/3L/1L for C, O, Fe); the self-validation answer key. For the Sun, absolute abundances are given.
